guides.title: Christmas lights
guides.intro: The best holiday light displays in and around Washington this season, with 2026 dates checked against the organizers and local guides.

items.name: ZooLights
items.blurb: Illuminated paths and light installations throughout the zoo, with hot cocoa.
items.blurbEs: Senderos iluminados e instalaciones de luz en todo el zoológico, con chocolate caliente.

items.name: Season's Greenings
items.blurb: Model trains, plant-made replicas of national landmarks and festive lights. Free.
items.blurbEs: Trenes a escala, réplicas de monumentos hechas de plantas y luces festivas. Gratis.

items.name: Enchant at Nationals Park
items.addr: 1500 S Capitol St SE, Washington, DC 20003
items.blurb: Light mazes, an ice-skating trail and Santa visits inside the ballpark.
items.blurbEs: Laberintos de luz, un sendero de patinaje y visitas de Santa dentro del estadio.

items.name: Wharf Holiday Boat Parade
items.blurb: More than 60 lit-up boats parade past the Wharf, followed by fireworks.
items.blurbEs: Más de 60 barcos iluminados desfilan por el Wharf, seguidos de fuegos artificiales.

items.name: Spectacular Factory at ARTECHOUSE
items.blurb: An indoor digital-art holiday 'gift factory' with giant nutcrackers and a candy cane carousel, plus a themed bar.
items.blurbEs: Una 'fábrica de regalos' de arte digital con cascanueces gigantes y un carrusel, más un bar temático.

items.name: Meadowlark's Winter Walk of Lights
items.blurb: A half-mile garden trail of nature-themed lights with a fire for s'mores.
items.blurbEs: Un sendero de media milla con luces inspiradas en la naturaleza y fogata para malvaviscos.
